title: Fix jmap-vtc-gateway-guide.md: CANCEL mapping wrong + cross-refs off by one
description: MUST-FIX: (1) SIP CANCEL→'declined' mapping is wrong. SIP CANCEL should map to endReason 'cancelled', not 'declined'. CANCEL means the initiator withdrew the request, not that the callee rejected it. (2) All section cross-references (§N citations) point to the wrong section — every one is off by one. This affects the entire document and will send implementers to the wrong spec sections. SHOULD-FIX: Remaining issues from gateway guide review to be cataloged during fix pass.
close_reason: All issues fixed across 11 VTC files
